title: Graduate civil engineer or civil draftsperson - expression of interest (Melbourne)
content_text:
Breese Pitt Dixon careers page (re-read 9 Oct 2026 AEST): We don't advertise individual vacancies here. If you'd like to explore a career with Breese Pitt Dixon, email us an introduction with your CV and a short note on the kind of work you're looking for. Email your expression of interest to info@bpd.com.au.
Who We're Looking For includes Graduate and experienced civil engineers; Survey Assistants, Technicians, Draftspersons, Graduate and Licensed Surveyors. Even if we're not recruiting in your discipline right now, we'd still like to hear from you.
Work includes designing major estates and critical infrastructure such as wetlands, retarding basins, trunk sewers, drainage and roads.
Office: 1/19 Cato Street Hawthorn East VIC 3123. Phone +61 3 8823 2300. Email info@bpd.com.au.
apply_instructions: Email EOI with CV to info@bpd.com.au (published on careers page).
